answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the lotus. By the reef of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
